review:
Forging Wilds is set in a blacksmith's forge with bellows, anvils and hammers on a 5x3 grid. Wilds carry multipliers from 2x to 10x, and multipliers add up when several wilds are in the same win.

Three scatters start free spins, with mini reels deciding how many you get. In the bonus, every wild stays sticky for a random number of spins, and more spins are awarded for landing more scatters. The RTP is 96.52%. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a max win. Sticky wilds with temporary lifespans add tension: you never know how long a good wild will stay.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
